botSettings.antiBanDesc: Prevent your WhatsApp number from being detected as spam or banned by adding intelligent random delays between outgoing messages. This applies to all actions: bot replies, auto-replies, broadcasts, scheduled messages, and API calls for this session.
botSettings.antiSpamDelayDesc: When enabled, messages will be queued and sent with a random delay if the rate limit is reached. Messages are never rejected — only delayed.
botSettings.howItWorksDesc: The system tracks how many messages this session sends within a time window. If the number of messages exceeds the threshold within the time window, each subsequent message will be delayed by a random amount between Min and Max delay. Once the time window resets (old messages expire), messages go back to normal speed.
botSettings.thresholdDesc: Number of messages allowed at full speed before delay kicks in.
botSettings.windowDesc: The rolling window to count messages. After this time passes, the counter resets naturally.
botSettings.safeSettingsTip: ⚠️ Recommended safe settings: Threshold 5, Window 10s, Delay 1000–3000ms. For high-volume broadcasts, use Threshold 3 with Delay 2000–5000ms.
botSettings.privacyDesc: Configure ghost mode and other features for your active session.
botSettings.ghostModeDesc: View status and read messages without sending blue ticks.
botSettings.antiDeleteDesc: Keep messages even if the sender deletes them for everyone.
